email.subject: Rapid Group Plumbing's site on phones
email.body:
Jack,

Quick note on Rapid Group Plumbing's site. It isn't set up for mobile, so when someone searches for a plumber from their phone during a leak or clog, the page is hard to use and they likely call the next listing instead. Since most emergency searches happen on phones, that's probably your biggest source of missed calls.

Also, your footer still shows info that looks outdated, which can make visitors second-guess if the business is active.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's costing you calls?

Alex
Northlight Web
